text_block_list.text:
From here on begins my journey, racing 
through the Twinkle 
Series hand in hand with my trainee 
horsegirl. 
And the name of the girl walking beside me 
is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I am Daring Tact. 
It is an honor to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I came to Tracen Academy to prove 
the strength of my own running— 
and in doing so, to prove the greatness of 
my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
For everyone back home who supports and 
believes 
in me, I will see this through without 
fail!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series alongside <chrname> 
had officially begun!
